story.originalTitle: What to expect from F1's newest race as Madring debuts
story.summaryEn: Formula 1 will race in Madrid for the first time in 45 years this weekend at the Madring circuit, which has secured a 10-year tenure of the Spanish Grand Prix. The 57-lap circuit is described as a two-headed monster that will take drivers and teams some time to understand from an engineering perspective.
detailZh: 随着马德里赛道赛道首秀，F1最新一站比赛值得期待什么
时隔45年，一级方程式本周末将首次在马德里比赛，赛道是具有双重特性的马德里赛道
马德里将承办西班牙大奖赛为期十年，从如今改为两年一届的巴塞罗那比赛中接过了这一名号，这是F1将赛事带到城市人口中心的最新举措。
比赛将在一条拥有“双头怪兽”之称的赛道上进行57圈，车手和车队需要一些时间才能让他们的工程思维完全理解这条赛道。
所谓的马德里赛道赛道最初的效果图引发了褒贬不一的反应，人们担心西班牙大奖赛从巴塞罗那的永久性赛道迁至马德里主机场附近的Valdebebas地区后，F1会再添一条千篇一律的街道赛，一个很快就会被弃用的钢筋水泥丛林。甚至无需走出西班牙国界，就能让人想起早已停办的瓦伦西亚大奖赛——那场在如今已成幽灵赛道上举办的、如海鲜饭锅般昙花一现的乏味比赛。
我们六月对现场的首次考察表明，这条最初由Dromo设计、后期施工阶段移交给Tilke完成的赛道，其最终成品Certainly远没有那些传言那么糟糕。但它也确实与赛历上其他任何一条赛道都不相同。
起终点直道周围区域位于IFEMA会展中心的广场和公共道路上，这无疑让第一个赛段有一种走走停停的感觉，令人联想到迈阿密和新加坡之类的赛道。
最醒目的地标，也是比赛官方海报和其他宣传材料上的主角，是La Monumental；这是一条长而快的倾斜弯道，坡度达到了允许的最大值24%。这条550米长的弯道比赞德沃特那条大致可类比的最后弯要长得多，因为它环绕赛道北端专门修建的区域划出了一个270度的弧线。
纪念碑赛道的陡峭弯道倾角具有不断变化的坡度和高度
这座高耸的弯道外侧设有大看台，其坡度、半径和高度的持续变化使其与赛历上的其他倾斜弯道或椭圆形赛道上的弯道截然不同，亲临现场时给人留下了震撼的印象。这里没有缓冲区，但外侧装有SAFER护栏。
“这是一个非常非常特别的弯道，” 勒克莱尔 在与法拉利进行尘土飞扬的拍摄日并勘察该弯道后说道。“在这个弯道，我感觉在排位赛中我们必须非常勇敢，因为它将达到极限。
“我确实相信它有潜力成为本赛季最具标志性的弯道之一，尤其是配上那个大看台。这将为这个弯道的体验增色。有一点是肯定的，那就是你必须全身心地投入。”
那个弯角之后是一连串的高速变向，而且缓冲区很小。正如一次红旗频出的F3测试所表明的那样，这条赛道在第一年将很难应付。
初步迹象表明，马德里赛道 即使不会成为车手们最喜欢的赛道，也将是在排位赛中颇具挑战性的赛道。不过，这条赛道能否呈现精彩的比赛场面，目前还没有定论。由于拥有众多制动区，这条赛道在能量回收的难度方面应该处于中游水平。超车看起来并不容易，3号弯和5号弯之间的直道是最明显的超车机会。
"这将是一条非常有挑战性的赛道，"Leclerc 委婉地说。"我不知道超车情况如何，我不确定会有很多超车，我希望我错了。但我认为排位赛以及驾驶这样一条赛道的挑战，将会是本赛季最酷的体验之一。"
马德里能为F1提供什么，而巴塞罗那仍在为此苦苦挣扎
马德里真正想做出差异化的是它的交通可达性。这条赛道不仅距离机场很近，还与马德里庞大的地铁和市郊铁路网络相连。主办方承诺从首都任何地方都能便捷无阻地抵达赛道，而这长期以来正是巴塞罗那的一大痛点。
在这方面，它正是F1管理层如今所青睐的那类场馆。一场与“目的地城市”深度融合的城市比赛，拥有各种配套设施、内置的交通与可持续解决方案，以及容纳大规模VIP设施的空间。
“嗯，你比我更清楚，进出一条传统赛道有多麻烦。这里南边有地铁，北边有市郊铁路，将会非常方便，”IFEMA的首席运营官Carlos Jimenez承诺道，“这两条线路都很快、停靠站很少，因为它们的设计初衷就是快速连接机场和市中心。所以，我们认为车迷抵达赛道的体验将是一个决定性的优势。
“这非常便利，但代价是我们必须更加努力，才能提供良好的现场体验。否则，车迷们会很快回到市里的酒店和餐厅，因为我们是在和市中心竞争。”
三级方程式（Formula 3）于八月底在该赛道进行了测试。
马德里能否兑现其承诺，顺利举办一届最多可容纳11万名观众的首届赛事，仍有待观察。最近有许多首届比赛成为学习机会的例子，包括迈阿密和拉斯维加斯。F1重返马德里很可能也会有不完善之处，但组织者表示他们已为此做好准备。
“这并不容易，”费尔南多·阿隆索（阿隆索）的前经纪人、现任该赛事总经理的路易斯·加西亚·阿巴德（Luis Garcia Abad）说，“我参与F1已经有25年了，我从没想过就你需要顾及的所有事情而言，会这么困难。”
“我一直与所有推广人交流，当你试图从零开始打造某样东西时，问题或多或少都是一样的。但IFEMA给我们提供了很多解决方案。我们本来没有赛道，但我们有Wi-Fi，有电力，主入口处还有地铁站。如果你试图在一个不同的场地组织赛事，那简直是一场噩梦。但有了这些（已经具备的）条件，我们得以把它建起来。”
“现在我们必须尽力提供我们能提供的最佳客户体验。”
detailEn: What to expect from F1's newest race as Madring debuts
For the first time in 45 years, Formula 1 will race in Madrid this weekend at the dual-natured Madring circuit
Madrid's 10-year tenure of the Spanish Grand Prix, taking over the moniker from the now biennial Barcelona race, is Formula 1's latest effort to bring its series to urban population centres.
It does so for 57 laps on a two-headed monster of a circuit that will take drivers and teams some time to wrap their collective engineering minds around.

Initial concept renderings of the so-called Madring drew mixed reactions with fears the Spanish GP's move from Barcelona's permanent circuit to the Valdebebas area near Madrid's main airport would see F1 add another generic street circuit, a concrete jungle that would soon be abandoned. One doesn't even have to look beyond the Spanish borders to evoke memories of the long-defunct Valencia grand prix, an uninspired flash in a paella-sized pan on what is now a ghost track.

Our first site visit in June suggested the circuit – originally designed by Dromo before the final stages of construction were handed over to Tilke – showed that the end product is certainly nowhere near as dramatic as that. But it certainly isn't like any other circuit on the calendar either.

The area around the start-and-finish straight is located around the IFEMA fairground concourse and public access roads, which certainly gives the first sector a stop-start feel reminiscent of the likes of Miami and Singapore.

The standout landmark, which features on the race official poster and other promotional material, is La Monumental; a long, fast banked corner featuring the maximum allowed 24% inclination. The 550-metre corner is much longer than Zandvoort's somewhat comparable final turn, as it draws a 270-degree arc around the northern, purpose-built end of the circuit.
The steep banking of La Monumental has a continuously changing gradient and elevation

The towering corner, which features a grandstand on the outside, made a staggering impression in person because of its continuous changes in gradient, radius and elevation that sets it apart from other banked corners on the calendar, or those found in oval races. There is no runoff, but the outside is lined with a SAFER barrier.

"It's a very, very special corner," Charles Leclerc said after exploring it during a dusty filming day with Ferrari. "It's a corner where I feel in qualifying we'll have to be very brave because it's going to be on the limit.

"I do believe it can become one of the most iconic corners of the season, especially with the grandstand. That will add to the experience of that corner. One thing is for sure, and that's that you will have to have full commitment."
That corner is followed by a number of high-speed direction changes with little run-off. As a red-flag-ridden F3 test suggested, the circuit will be tricky to handle in year one.

Early indications suggest that the Madring, if not an outright driver favourite, will be a respectable driving challenge in qualifying. The jury is still out on whether the circuit will be able to deliver a compelling spectacle, though. Because of its many braking zones, the circuit should sit in the middle of the pack in terms of energy-harvesting challenges. Overtaking does not look particularly easy, with the straight between Turns 3 and 5 the most obvious opportunity.

"It's going to be a very challenging track," Leclerc said diplomatically. "I don't know about the overtakes, I'm not sure there will be that many overtakes, I hope I'm wrong. But I think qualifying and the challenge of driving such a track is going to be one of the very cool ones of the season."
What Madrid can offer F1 that Barcelona still struggles with

Where Madrid wants to make a real difference is its accessibility. The circuit is not just a close drive from the airport, but is also connected to Madrid's extensive underground and commuter train network. The organisers promise hassle-free access to the circuit from anywhere in the capital, something which has long been a pain point in Barcelona.

In that respect it is exactly the type of venue that F1 management has become infatuated with. An urban race well integrated into a 'destination city', with all the amenities, baked-in mobility and sustainability solutions, and room for extensive VIP facilities.

"Well, you know better than me that coming in and out of a traditional circuit is a nightmare. Here we have both the metro in the south and the commuter train in the north, which is going to be extremely convenient," IFEMA's COO Carlos Jimenez promised. "Both are very fast lines with very few stops because they were designed to quickly connect the airport with the city centre. So, the experience for the fans to reach the circuit, we think it's going to be a difference-maker.

"It's very convenient, but the counterpart is that it obliges us to work harder to provide a good experience. Otherwise, the fans will quickly go back to the hotels and restaurants in the city, because we are competing with the city centre."
Formula 3 conducted a track test at the circuit at the end of August

Whether or not Madrid can make good on its promise to organise a smooth inaugural edition of its event, for a maximum capacity of 110,000 spectators, remains to be seen. There have been many recent examples of year one being a learning opportunity, including Miami and Las Vegas. F1's return to Madrid will likely be rough around the edges, too, but the organisers say they are prepared for that.

"It's not easy," said Luis Garcia Abad, Fernando Alonso's former manager and now the managing director of the event. "I have been involved in F1 for the last 25 years and I never thought that it was going to be so difficult in terms of all the things that you have to be aware of.

"I have been speaking with all the promoters, and the problems are more or less the same when you are trying to build something from scratch. But IFEMA gave us a lot of solutions. We didn't have a racetrack, but we had Wi-Fi, we had energy, we had a metro station at the main entrance. If you are trying to organise something in a different circuit, it's a nightmare. But with all these parameters [already in place], we were able to build it.
"Now we have to deliver the best customer experience we can."

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."
